intent: Determine whether a Schneider Electric Extension Cable variant (line 'Schneider Electric Heavy Duty Merten 214-ZHY Extension Cable', color family White, length 3 m) exists in the catalogue.
success_criteria: SQL returns zero or more product_variants rows scoped to brand=Schneider Electric, series=Heavy Duty, model=Merten 214-ZHY with color_family=White and length=3 m.
Answer states <YES> with the matched variant's record_path if a row exists, else <NO>.
Every matched variant's record_path is cited in refs.

args.stdin: SELECT v.product_sku, v.product_name, v.brand, v.series, v.model, v.record_path FROM product_variants v JOIN product_kinds k ON k.product_kind_id = v.product_kind_id WHERE v.brand = :brand AND v.series = :series AND v.model = :model AND k.product_kind_name = :kind_name AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pc WHERE pc.product_sku = v.product_sku AND pc.property_key = 'color_family' AND LOWER(pc.property_value_text) = LOWER(:color_family)) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties pl WHERE pl.product_sku = v.product_sku AND pl.property_key LIKE '%length%' AND (pl.property_value_number = :length_m OR LOWER(pl.property_value_text) = LOWER(:length_text)));

agents_md_constraints.rule: When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.

answer_template.message: { '<YES> The Schneider Electric Heavy Duty Merten 214-ZHY Extension Cable in White, 3 m (' + matches[0].product_sku + ') is in the catalogue.' if matches else '<NO> No Schneider Electric Heavy Duty Merten 214-ZHY Extension Cable with color family White and length 3 m is in the catalogue.' }
